subject.title: feat(exec): expose knownLongFlags in safeBinProfiles config schema

question: Should OpenClaw accept `tools.exec.safeBinProfiles.<bin>.knownLongFlags` as public operator config for custom safe bins?
rationale: Root policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces, and this field changes the exec safe-bin security boundary even though the implementation is technically focused.

options.title: Approve public field and align docs
options.body: Accept `knownLongFlags` as public config, require the `docs/tools/exec.md` overview update, and merge after normal owner/security review.

options.title: Keep the metadata internal
options.body: Close or pause this PR and solve custom boolean/known long-option handling with a narrower design that does not add this config field.

options.title: Defer for broader safe-bin design
options.body: Hold this PR with related safe-bin PRs until maintainers settle the full custom/default safe-bin option model.

recommendation.title: Approve public field and align docs
recommendation.body: Accept `knownLongFlags` as public config, require the `docs/tools/exec.md` overview update, and merge after normal owner/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: The safe-bin policy and long-option validation history points to this owner as the best available decision route.
